earlier_fixture_failures: Hidden Electron frame scheduling fixed by offscreen rendering; no product timing delay introduced.
Keyboard End assertion uses actual sorted index rather than language-dependent filename order.
Native virtual list preserves focused offscreen row; file selection now matches file semantics.
Native normal Markdown may render in workspace previewer rather than File.bundle; open-source verification reads active normal document tab and rendered content.
limitations: 未在Win10或真实SSH服务器现场复查目录预览；远端异步文件提供者端口已覆盖，不能替代真实网络验收。
沿用现有只读文本类型和2MiB预览限制；目录不提供写操作，也不递归扫描项目。
用户窗口未重启，保存后正常重启加载；用户暂缓的保存误报保持原状态。
